primary_transactions: Rental charges, deposits, damage waivers, late fees, sales of used rental assets and lease arrangements.
profiles.inventory_pattern: Rental fleet/equipment held for use; consumable or sale inventory and owned/leased fleet distinctions matter.
profiles.revenue_pattern: Daily/monthly rentals, usage, deposits/waivers, cancellation/refund and resale proceeds.
profiles.asset_pattern: Fleet/equipment, right-of-use assets, deposits, receivables and maintenance WIP.
profiles.labor_pattern: Counter/service, fleet maintenance, logistics and recovery labor.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Vehicle/equipment titles, insurance, consumer contracts, damage claims and local licensing.

priority_questions.rationale: Fleet-level depreciation, maintenance and utilization support asset profitability.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object

priority_questions.rationale: Reservations, check-out/return and billing events must tie to the ledger.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

priority_questions.rationale: Customer identity, payment and location data need access controls.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text

priority_questions.rationale: Rental and leasing contracts convey asset-use rights; fleet ownership, term, options, deposits and residual value must be identified.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction

priority_questions.rationale: Rental charges, deposits, waivers, refunds and used-asset sales are contract revenue streams distinct from third-party healthcare reimbursement.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration

material_exceptions.exception: 532111/532112 passenger vehicle rental and leasing differ in fleet ownership, term and maintenance exposure.
532120 truck/utility leasing may involve commercial contracts and residual-value risk.
532210 consumer-goods rental has recurring collections and return-condition evidence.
532490 equipment rental may bundle operators, delivery or service; identify separate performance obligations.

profiles.title: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)
business_roles: Owners/license holders of patents, trademarks, franchise rights and other nonfinancial intangibles grant use rights; brokers or agents may arrange licenses.
primary_transactions: Franchise fees, patent/trademark licenses, royalties and access rights excluding copyrighted works.
profiles.inventory_pattern: Rights portfolios and contract assets; licensed rights are not merchandise inventory.
profiles.revenue_pattern: Upfront fees, recurring royalties, minimum guarantees and usage/territory charges.
profiles.asset_pattern: Intangible rights, contract receivables, deferred costs and deposits.
profiles.labor_pattern: Licensing, legal, royalty administration and franchise support labor.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Rights registration, franchise disclosure/contract terms, territory restrictions and third-party ownership.

priority_questions.rationale: License term, scope, usage and reversions determine access/use rights and revenue.
required_facts: identified asset/right, control, useful life and restriction

priority_questions.rationale: Royalty statements and usage data must tie through contract/version changes.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

priority_questions.rationale: Confidential licensee and product data require access and retention controls.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text

priority_questions.rationale: Granting, amending and terminating rights requires authorized approval.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship

material_exceptions.exception: 533110 patent/franchise lessors may grant operating rights without owning physical goods.
Copyrighted works are excluded from this subsector and belong in publishing/content analysis.
Franchise support services may be separate from the intangible right.

profiles.title: Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
business_roles: Lawyers, accountants, architects, engineers, designers, consultants, laboratories and other specialists deliver expertise; staffing/placement roles are separate in 5613.

profiles.revenue_pattern: Time-and-material, milestones, retainers, contingencies, pass-throughs and acceptance-based fees.
profiles.asset_pattern: WIP/contract assets, receivables, client-fund liabilities, equipment and IP.
profiles.labor_pattern: Professional labor, subcontractors and project teams; utilization and independence can be material.

priority_questions.rationale: Project WIP and labor utilization require engagement-level cost tracing.

priority_questions.rationale: Client data transformations and workpapers need reproducible lineage.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

priority_questions.rationale: Professional opinions and client-fund disbursements require assigned authority.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship

required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

541613/541614 consultants may have fixed-fee/milestone or retainer obligations.

profiles.revenue_pattern: Hourly/T&M, recurring availability, placement event, managed-service, reimbursable and pass-through billing.
profiles.asset_pattern: Receivables, WIP, equipment, deposits and payroll/tax liabilities for staffing/PEO roles.
profiles.labor_pattern: Large operational labor pool, temporary workers, client-site staff, supervisors, dispatch and support teams.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Employment/payroll, privacy, security, licensing, client-site safety and service-level terms.

priority_questions.rationale: Site/team labor and supplies need client/job-level cost tracing.

priority_questions.rationale: Placement, call, facility and payroll records require source-to-invoice lineage.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

priority_questions.rationale: Client-site access, employee data and confidential records require controls.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text

priority_questions.rationale: Hiring, payroll release, client commitments and incident escalation need assigned authority.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship

priority_questions.rationale: Temporary-help and PEO roles turn worker status, client supervision, wages, deductions and taxes into central obligations.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object

priority_questions.rationale: Staffing and support billings require contract, hours, pass-through and acceptance evidence; healthcare payer reimbursement is not presumed.

561210 facilities support bundles operating staff and supplies inside client facilities.
561410/561421 document preparation and telephone answering expose client data and recurring service logs.

profiles.title: Waste Management and Remediation Services
business_roles: Waste collection, treatment, disposal, remediation and material-recovery operators take custody of waste or recover saleable material; brokers and transporters may have different roles.

profiles.revenue_pattern: Route/volume fees, project milestones, tipping charges, regulatory remediation and recovered-material sales.
profiles.asset_pattern: Vehicles, treatment/disposal facilities, environmental reserves/obligations, WIP and receivables.
profiles.labor_pattern: Drivers, plant operators, environmental engineers, sorters and remediation crews.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Environmental permits, hazardous-waste custody/manifest, closure obligations and safety rules.

priority_questions.rationale: Route, facility and remediation-project costs need volume/job tracing.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object

priority_questions.rationale: Waste manifests and weight records must tie to billing and compliance reports.
required_facts: transaction type, counterparty/payer, completion or settlement status

priority_questions.rationale: Hazardous-material and customer/site data require access and retention controls.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text

priority_questions.rationale: Acceptance, disposal and environmental incident decisions require authority.
required_facts: legal entity, provider/administrator/owner role, control relationship

required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text

562211 hazardous-waste treatment/disposal has custody, manifest and environmental liability conditions.

562920 material recovery facilities may own recovered materials for resale; output differs from fee-only disposal.

profiles.title: Educational Services
business_roles: Schools, colleges, training centers, and contract operators that both manage facilities and provide operating staff; the establishment is the service provider, while students, sponsors, governments and grantors are payers or funders.
primary_transactions: Tuition/enrollment, course delivery, student aid, grants, appropriations, refunds and contract training.
profiles.inventory_pattern: Usually no merchandise inventory; instructional materials, labs, consumables and aircraft/equipment training assets are operational inputs.
profiles.revenue_pattern: Tuition recognized over instructional service/term facts; grants and appropriations follow award conditions and legal entity; refunds and deposits need separate schedules.
profiles.asset_pattern: Campuses, labs, libraries, aircraft and leased facilities; ownership and restricted-use terms drive capitalization.
profiles.labor_pattern: Faculty, adjuncts, staff and instructors; payroll by program/term and public/private/nonprofit employer matters.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Accreditation, licensure, student-aid rules and grant restrictions; classification does not select GASB, FASB or IFRS.

priority_questions.rationale: Term/course delivery and refund evidence determines timing.

award agreement, conditions, restricted purpose, compliance costs

priority_questions.rationale: Adjunct, faculty and staff cost follows legal employer and program.

employment terms, timesheets, benefit plan, payroll entity

profiles.title: Ambulatory Health Care Services
business_roles: Physicians, clinics, laboratories, home-health and emergency providers deliver outpatient care; patients, insurers, HMOs and public programs are payers, and a government administrator is not automatically the care provider.
primary_transactions: Patient encounters, tests, episodes, capitation, fee-for-service, supplies, referrals and payer settlements.
profiles.inventory_pattern: Clinical drugs, implants, blood/organ custody and consumables; lab specimens and patient property require chain-of-custody controls.
profiles.revenue_pattern: Revenue depends on authorized service, payer contract, encounter/episode completion and denials; capitation differs from fee-for-service.
profiles.asset_pattern: Medical equipment, EHR systems, leased clinics and regulated specimens; impairment and useful life are entity-specific.
profiles.labor_pattern: Clinicians, technicians, home-health aides and credentialed contractors; labor cost follows service line and legal employer.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Licensure, HIPAA/privacy, payer authorization, CLIA/lab rules, Medicare/Medicaid and HMO contracts.

priority_questions.rationale: Claims aging and denial/recoupment evidence drive receivables.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
encounter record, claim, remittance, denial, payer contract

priority_questions.rationale: Public/insurer reimbursement is not interchangeable with patient revenue.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
authorization, eligibility, fee schedule, cost report

priority_questions.rationale: Clinical inventory and implants require lot, expiry and custody controls.
required_facts: title/ownership, custody location, unit/lot and valuation evidence
item ledger, lot/expiry, usage, count, disposal

priority_questions.rationale: Patient data and role access affect source reliability.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
access logs, consent, privacy incident records

priority_questions.rationale: Credentialed labor and contractor status affect costing.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object

material_exceptions.exception: 621491 HMO capitation versus fee-for-service; 621492 dialysis bundled reimbursement; 621991 blood/organ custody; 621610 home-health episode authorization. Census classification does not choose healthcare GAAP or payer law.

profiles.title: Hospitals
business_roles: General, psychiatric and specialty hospitals operate inpatient facilities; patients, insurers, governments, donors and research sponsors fund care. A public hospital administrator and a private hospital provider need separate legal-entity analysis.
primary_transactions: Admissions, patient accounts, bundled procedures, charity care, implants, pharmacy, grants and payer settlements.
profiles.inventory_pattern: Pharmacy, blood, implants and surgical supplies; lot/expiry, charge capture and unused-stock controls are material.
profiles.revenue_pattern: Room/day, procedure and bundle revenue follows admission/discharge and payer terms; charity, bad debt, contractual allowances and restricted gifts need distinct treatment.
profiles.asset_pattern: Buildings, imaging and surgical equipment, right-of-use assets and restricted gifts; componentization and impairment depend on framework.
profiles.labor_pattern: Clinicians, nurses, residents and support staff; shift, department, agency and benefit allocations affect cost.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Hospital licensure, privacy, payer programs, charity obligations, safety and specialty reimbursement rules.

priority_questions.rationale: Contractual allowances, denials and charity care change patient receivable measurement.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration
patient ledger, payer remittance, charity policy, aging

priority_questions.rationale: Inpatient stay and bundled procedures require service-period and obligation evidence.
required_facts: customer or payer, promised output, service/occupancy/claim status and consideration

priority_questions.rationale: Implants and pharmacy stock need charge, lot and expiry reconciliation.
required_facts: title/ownership, custody location, unit/lot and valuation evidence
inventory issue, implant log, pharmacy count

priority_questions.rationale: Malpractice, self-insurance and remediation obligations are separate estimates.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
claims register, counsel letter, insurance terms

priority_questions.rationale: Restricted gifts and research awards are not automatically patient revenue.
required_facts: regulator/contract, eligibility or restriction, compliance event and effective text
gift agreement, sponsor terms, eligible costs

material_exceptions.exception: 622210 behavioral-health privacy/reimbursement; 622310 specialty bundles and implants; teaching/research and government/private/nonprofit ownership alter evidence and reporting basis.

profiles.title: Nursing and Residential Care Facilities

profiles.asset_pattern: Facilities, improvements, beds/equipment and leased property; continuing-care commitments may create long-term obligations.
profiles.labor_pattern: Licensed nurses, aides, therapists and agency workers; staffing ratios and shift records drive cost and compliance.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Facility licensing, staffing/safety rules, Medicaid/Medicare authorization, resident-protection and deposit requirements.

priority_questions.rationale: Future-care promises and refunds can create obligations beyond current service.

continuing-care contract, actuarial estimate, refund terms

priority_questions.rationale: Regulated staffing and agency labor require service-line attribution.
required_facts: legal employer, worker classification, time/benefit population and cost object
roster, credentials, shift log, agency invoice

priority_questions.rationale: Medication and resident property custody require controlled counts.
required_facts: title/ownership, custody location, unit/lot and valuation evidence

priority_questions.rationale: Emergency donated goods require receipt, custody and distribution evidence.

priority_questions.rationale: Program labor and volunteer contributions need legal-entity and cost-center clarity.

profiles.revenue_pattern: Admissions and memberships follow access; wagering liabilities settle on outcomes; comps, refunds and revenue-share contracts need separate evidence.
profiles.asset_pattern: Rides, gaming equipment, venues, right-of-use assets and security systems.
profiles.labor_pattern: Attendants, dealers, security, concessions and seasonal staff; tips and regulated roles need separate payroll controls.
profiles.regulated_conditions: Gaming licenses, responsible-gaming, cash controls, prize rules, safety, alcohol and tax filings.
